title: Capture a customer signature
body:
## Acceptance criteria
- [x] A signature can be drawn and saved to the inspection.
- [x] The signature is shown on the report.
- [ ] Works on a 320-point-wide screen with the keyboard open.
notes:
## Notes
Drawing and saving work. The small-screen case was not tried yet.

title: Retry failed photo uploads
body:
## Acceptance criteria
- [x] A failed upload is retried up to three times.
- [x] The user sees which photos are still waiting.
notes:
## Notes
Retries are tested. The waiting list is on the inspection screen.

title: Barcode scanning for equipment tags
body: Scan a tag with the camera to open the equipment record.
notes: Works on both test phones. The oldest Android phone is slow to focus.

title: Alert before the sync gateway certificate expires
body: Send an alert thirty days before the certificate of the sync gateway expires.
